ticket.summary: Customer's garbage disposal hummed without spinning due to a peach pit jam; talked through PB-07 self-clear over text and unit is working again — no visit needed.
mitigation_advice: Never put hands inside the disposal, even when switched off [PB-07]
Unplug the unit (or switch off its breaker) before working on it [PB-07]
Remove the visible obstruction (peach pit) with tongs/pliers [PB-07]
Use the hex/Allen socket under the unit to rock the flywheel free, then restore power and test [PB-07]
ticket.customer_message: Happy to help, Bea! Glad it was a quick fix. If it ever hums again or you notice a leak under the sink, text us and we'll get someone out. Have a good night! Address confirmed: 3 Sandpiper Way, phone +1-555-0112. No charge for tonight.
